rule: G8.3: every figure asserted on a result surface must differ between seed A and seed B, or be listed here with the reason it cannot.

seedInvariant.name: the unassignable chip
seedInvariant.reason: estimateAdmixture returns five proportions that sum to 1, and src/lib/ancestry/present.ts computes this chip as max(0, 1 - assigned), so it is 0.0% for every genome. It is registered rather than dropped from collection because a non-zero value would mean the estimator had begun leaving mass unattributed, which is worth seeing.
